statusDetail: Cloudflare interactive bot verification intercepted https://artfight.net in fresh system-Chrome sessions. After 3 s and 12 s waits the browser still showed “Performing security verification” with a “Verify you are human” control; a direct HTTP request returned 403. The authored Art Fight pages, routes, controls, and flows were therefore unreachable.

page.notes: The origin returned a Cloudflare managed challenge, so the application architecture and page templates could not be identified.

artifacts.caption: Desktop recon shows the Cloudflare human-verification wall instead of Art Fight.
Mobile retry after 12 seconds remains intercepted by the Cloudflare challenge.
Rendered DOM and CSS belong to the Cloudflare challenge, not the target application.
Recon probe reports title “Just a moment…”, robots noindex,nofollow, and only Cloudflare links.
Headers captured from the challenge response; they cannot establish the application response headers.
Direct request response headers begin with HTTP/2 403.
Direct response body is the Cloudflare “Just a moment…” challenge.
Atomic plan containing all 58 expected principle/check pairs.
Atomic coverage validator output: 58 expected and recorded, all 58 blocked; publication gate fails as required for an incomplete run.
